sell.title: Sell your materials by the sheet, roll, pack or carton.
sell.intro: List on MaterialHub and reach UAE trade buyers and craft shoppers from one catalogue, without running your own storefront.
sell.signIn: Already a supplier? Sign in to the vendor dashboard
sell.categoriesBody: Seven categories cover the materials chain. Your listings sit in the one that fits, next to competing suppliers, by spec and unit of measure.

payments.t: Buyers pay the way they want
payments.d: Card through Stripe, Tabby and Tamara instalments, and cash on delivery. MaterialHub collects the payment for you.

payouts.d: Sales are paid out on a set schedule, minus the platform commission. Commission can be a percentage, a fixed amount or tiered, and is agreed with you before you list.

shipping.d: Shipments are booked on the platform carrier account by default, from the warehouses you add. Prefer your own carrier? Switch it off.

dashboard.d: Listings, variants, inventory, orders, shipments, returns, coupons and payouts. Import and export listings in bulk, and add your team with their own roles.

integrations.d: Signed outbound webhooks and sales-channel feeds keep your stock and orders in step with the tools you already use.

bilingual.d: The storefront runs in both languages, right to left in Arabic, on desktop and phone.

apply.d: Send your business name, trade licence number, VAT registration if you have one, and a contact.

verify.d: Upload your KYC documents. The MaterialHub team reviews them and approves your account.

setup.d: Add a bank account for payouts and the warehouses you ship from.

list.d: Add your materials with their specs, units and prices, one by one or in bulk.

sell.closingBody: Applications are reviewed by the MaterialHub team. Your commission and payout schedule are set out in your vendor agreement before you go live.
